_meta.note: Global deal banners as printed on the official news pages (read through the Wayback Machine). Source of ios-server/devtools/build_deals.py, which writes gacha_deals.json. Ids 95xxxxx. See ios-server/BANNER_DEALS_RESEARCH.md.

banners.name: Lunar New Year: 14 Days of Free Summons
banners.notes: One free summon a day for 14 days. The page names no pool rule; this uses permanent units released before the start. Banner art not archived: titled stand-in.

banners.name: 5★ Guaranteed Cash Summon
banners.notes: Global sold this once-per-player 10+1 (5★ guaranteed, no limited units) for real money. Stand-in price 10,000 Lapis (operator's choice, 2026-11-07). Banner art not archived: titled stand-in.

banners.name: 30 Million Downloads: Free Daily Summon
banners.notes: Round 1 of the 30M DL celebration: one free summon a day for 19 days; the pool took in the FFXV and FFIX units added on 3/1-3/2. Art is the celebration's general image.

banners.name: 30 Million Downloads Celebratory Summon
banners.notes: Round 2: a daily login ticket gave 2 units (3-5★) and a 4★ Trust Moogle (ALL 5%) or 5★ Trust Moogle (ALL 10%). Served as a free daily summon instead of a ticket. The moogle odds weren't published: 80/20 is a guess.

banners.name: FREE DAILY SUMMON (April 2018)
banners.notes: One free summon a day; the pool took in the FFX units (Yuna, Lulu, Seymour, Wakka) added 4/6.

banners.name: FREE DAILY SUMMON (May 2018)
banners.notes: One free summon a day; the pool took in Nameless Gunner Jake, Emperor Shera, Ozetta, Camille and Riley.

banners.name: STEP UP SUMMON (Sephiroth / Lila)
banners.notes: Global's first step-up: 5 steps of 5000 Lapis for 11 units, three rounds per player. Step bonuses read from the step image: 5★ Trust Moogle (ALL 10%), 4★ Shylt, a 5★ unit, a 10% 5★ Summon Ticket, then Sephiroth or Lila.

banners.name: STEP UP SUMMON - CLOUD SPECIAL!
banners.notes: Same format as the Sephiroth step-up: 5 x 5000 Lapis, three rounds. Steps from the step image: 5★ Trust Moogle (ALL 10%), 4★ William, a 5★ unit, a 10% 5★ Summon Ticket, then Cloud or Elfreeda. The list banner isn't archived; the step image is used for both.

banners.name: STEP UP SUMMON (Raegen)
banners.notes: The discounted step-up: 500/1000/1500/3000/5000 Lapis for 1/2/4/6/11 units, one round. Step 1 had 1.5x and step 5 5x the chance of a 5★ Raegen; Raegen's normal share of 5★ draws (a third) is raised 1.5x and 3x (5x would make every 5★ Raegen).

banners.name: 5% Rainbow Rate Free Daily Summon
banners.notes: The Player's Voice prize: a free daily summon at a 5% rainbow rate, no limited units. Banner art not archived: titled stand-in.

banners.name: SPECIAL RATE UP SUMMON
banners.notes: 5% rainbow rate on 11 summons (5000 Lapis), five per player; every 5★ up to the Nalu batch except limited units.

banners.name: Free 10+1 Summon featuring Fan Festa Units (Malphasie / Circe)
banners.notes: A free 10+1, once per player, with raised rates for Malphasie and Circe.

banners.name: DAILY FREE RARE SUMMON (FFXV)
banners.notes: One free summon a day for a week, permanent units added before 10/5.

banners.name: Free 10+1 Summon featuring Fan Festa Units (Beryl / Ellesperis)
banners.notes: A free 10+1, once per player, with raised rates for Beryl and Ellesperis.

banners.name: Free 10+1 Summon featuring Kingdom Hearts Units
banners.notes: A free 10+1, once per player, with raised rates for Sora and Cloud (KH). Banner art not archived: titled stand-in.
